# --schema=https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema resolves
# locally from the embedded copy, no network needed.
jsch validate --schema https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema instance.json

# --schema-2020-12 is sugar for the canonical URL above.
jsch validate --schema-2020-12 instance.json

# A bogus schema is caught by the meta-schema pre-flight check
# unless the caller opts out.
! jsch validate --schema bogus.json instance.json
stderr 'fails JSON Schema 2020-12 meta-schema validation'

# With --skip-schema-validation the bogus schema is accepted by
# loadSchema and only the instance-level validation runs. The
# bogus schema rejects the instance for missing the required
# property, but the failure no longer mentions the meta-schema.
! jsch validate --schema bogus.json --skip-schema-validation instance.json
! stderr 'meta-schema'

-- instance.json --
{"type":"string"}
-- bogus.json --
{"required":["a","a"]}
